# NeuralOps Community & Support Guidelines

Welcome to the NeuralOps community! Whether you are exploring subquadratic attention mechanisms, deploying model compression in production, or conducting research, here is how you can engage with the project.

---

## 💬 Where to Get Help

| Channel | Best For | Link |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **GitHub Discussions** | Questions, architecture ideas, research discussions, sharing benchmarks | [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/tahamajs/SVD_linear_Attention/discussions) |
| **GitHub Issues** | Bug reports, reproducible regressions, feature requests | [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/tahamajs/SVD_linear_Attention/issues) |
| **Documentation** | API reference, tutorials, architectural specifications | [Documentation](https://tahamajs.github.io/SVD_linear_Attention/) |
| **Hugging Face Hub** | Pre-trained models, checkpoints, distilled student models | [Hugging Face Hub](https://huggingface.co/tahamajs/distilbert-svd-attention) |

---

## 🐛 Reporting Bugs

Before opening an issue:
1. Search existing [Issues](https://github.com/tahamajs/SVD_linear_Attention/issues) and [Discussions](https://github.com/tahamajs/SVD_linear_Attention/discussions) to check if the topic has been addressed.
2. Run `neuralops doctor` to capture your environment setup (PyTorch, CUDA, Triton, GPU SM capability).
3. Provide a minimal, reproducible code snippet that reproduces the issue.

---

## 🔒 Security Vulnerabilities

Please do not report security vulnerabilities via public GitHub issues. See our [Security Policy](SECURITY.md) for reporting procedures.
